definitions: To follow the track or scent of (a person or animal).
To draw or be drawn along the ground or other surface behind something or someone.
To lag behind (a competitor or opponent) in a race or other contest.
examples: The hunters trailed the deer for hours.
Her long dress trailed on the floor.
The runner trailed the leader by a few seconds.
He trailed home after a long day at work.
The sound of the music trailed off.
